verdict.rationale: Chronicle accepts telemetry from your own code, from agent tool calls, or from a generic OpenTelemetry exporter, and agent processes get a traces:write key, so instrumentation is possible. No first-party integrations for LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK are documented, so connecting those frameworks would mean building your own OpenTelemetry instrumentation. Missing for 10: named framework integrations for LangChain, OpenAI SDK, and Vercel AI SDK; setup docs for auto-instrumentation; independent or hands-on corroboration.
